question: Who explained the place of awakened and unawakened?
premises: Shri Shambhu spread the day-night order to me
the place is of awakened and unawakened
inference: the guru explains the place of awakened and unawakened
plain_english: Shri Shambhu thus spread the day-night order to me; Shri Santanaguru said the place of awakened and unawakened.
